diagnoses.label: No segment merge/clamp contract between combiner and processor
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Location hint flags “segment-combiner/SKILL.md 的区间合并约定，以及 video-processor/SKILL.md 的相应调用和检查”. In segment-combiner/SKILL.md Notes: “Segments are sorted by start time” and script combine_segments.py only concatenates and sorts; it does not merge overlaps, clamp to video duration, or validate start<end. Meanwhile video-processor/SKILL.md pipeline step 4 requires “Combine, sort, clamp, and de-overlap all removal segments.” video-processor/scripts/process_video.py assumes sorted, non-overlapping remove_segments when computing keep segments (current_time = seg['end']), which will break if overlaps/out-of-order exist.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Any workflow that combines multiple removal segment sources (opening + pauses) before video processing
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Single-source segment lists already guaranteed non-overlapping and within bounds
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Define an explicit, testable contract for combined segments: sorted, numeric, start<end, duration≈end-start, clamped to [0, video_duration], and merged/de-overlapped (union) before passing to video-processor; document whether adjacency (end==start) should be merged.

diagnoses.label: Processor lacks enforcement/validation of removal segment invariants
diagnoses.observable_evidence: video-processor/SKILL.md completion checks require “segments are sorted and non-overlapping” and “duration ≈ end - start”. But video-processor/scripts/process_video.py load_segments() only sorts; it does not validate numeric types, start<end, clamp to duration, recompute/verify duration fields, or merge overlaps. calculate_keep_segments() will produce incorrect keep intervals if remove segments overlap or extend beyond total_duration.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: input segment validation + normalization before keep-segment inversion
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Before building keep segments and ffmpeg filter_complex in process_video.py for any removal list not guaranteed clean
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Pipelines where upstream guarantees strict invariants and processor is intentionally minimal
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add a normalization/validation step after loading segments: coerce to floats/ints, drop/raise on invalid segments, clamp to [0,total_duration], sort, merge overlaps/adjacent per contract, and recompute duration; then compute keep segments from the normalized union.

diagnoses.label: SKILL docs conflict on whether processor accepts multiple segment files vs unified combined file
diagnoses.observable_evidence: video-processor/SKILL.md shows two modes: --remove-segments /path/to/segments.json and also “Or multiple segment files: ... --remove-segments opening.json pauses.json”. segment-combiner/SKILL.md says it prepares unified input for video-processor and claims compatibility, but does not specify whether video-processor expects already-merged segments or will merge itself. The location hint explicitly requests checking “相应调用和检查” in video-processor/SKILL.md, implying the documented pipeline call path is unclear/inconsistent.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: pipeline wiring: when to call segment-combiner vs pass multiple files directly
diagnoses.scope_boundary: End-to-end silence-removal pipeline documentation and invocation order
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Standalone use of video-processor where user manually supplies a single curated segments file
diagnoses.target_section: Usage / Mandatory end-to-end completion gate step 4
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Clarify the canonical pipeline: either (A) always run segment-combiner to produce a single normalized all_segments.json consumed by video-processor, or (B) allow multiple inputs but require video-processor to normalize/merge; align docs and checks to the chosen contract.

overlay.composition_issue: Segment-combiner currently only concatenates+sorts, while video-processor assumes non-overlapping segments for inversion; this mismatch can create incorrect keep segments and invalid ffmpeg trims, undermining the completion checks that require sorted non-overlapping segments with consistent durations.
preservation_constraints: Preserve existing detector output formats (silence-detector and pause-detector emit {method, segments, ...})
Preserve video-processor ability to accept one or more JSON inputs via --remove-segments
Preserve report-generator’s task-format JSON fields and ffprobe-based duration measurement behavior

package_assessment.rationale: The defect is localized to the segment interface between segment-combiner and video-processor (documentation + normalization/validation). Fixing the contract and enforcing it in the processor can be done within the existing bundle without changing external tools or requiring hidden task-specific heuristics.
